questions.stem_text:
__________ memory is the aspect of memory that is involved in the recall of information
acquired within the past few hours to days.

According to Irvin Yalom, ________in group therapy is the analogue of the therapist-client
relationship in individual therapy.

If a psychologist acts as both a fact witness for the plaintiff and an expert witness for
the court in a criminal trial, she has acted:

options.A: unethically unless she obtains a waiver from the plaintiff.
options.B: ethically as long as she did not have a prior relationship with the plaintiff.
options.C: unethically unless she has a prior relationship with the defendant.
options.D: ethically as long as she maintains neutrality throughout the trial.
options.E: ethically only if she has a prior relationship with the defendant.

questions.answer_explanation: Correct option: A - unethically unless she obtains a waiver from the plaintiff.

questions.stem_text:
Each of the following is a step taken by a therapist who is employing systematic
desensitization EXCEPT

options.A: having the client confront the actual feared object or situation
options.B: instructing the client to picture each fearful image while maintaining a relaxed state
options.C: constructing a hierarchy of feared images
options.D: helping the client experience the desired state of relaxation through hypnosis
options.E: instructing the client to express their feelings about each feared image

questions.answer_explanation: Correct option: D - helping the client experience the desired state of relaxation through hypnosis
